title: Lesson library
intro: Short interactive lessons on computational thinking, software, data, the cloud and AI. Each lesson stands alone, so a course can use any of them in any order.

areas.label: Web applications
areas.about: How a request travels from a browser to a server and back, and what the messages contain.

areas.label: Data and databases
areas.about: How to describe data as tables, change it safely and choose a database.

areas.label: Capacity and cloud
areas.about: How much a server can handle, how to add machines and what the cloud costs.

areas.label: Architecture
areas.about: How to divide an application into parts and what each division costs.

areas.label: Language models and AI
areas.about: How a language model learns, reads and writes, and how to use one with care.

areas.label: Practice
areas.about: Group work that uses what the other lessons teach.

areas.label: Computational thinking
areas.about: How to frame a problem, break it into parts, find patterns, and write steps that someone else or a computer can follow.
